model.harbor_lease.int_leases_enriched.name: int_leases_enriched
model.harbor_lease.int_leases_enriched.raw_code:
-- One row per lease with unit, property and tenant attributes attached.
select
    l.lease_id,
    l.tenant_id,
    l.unit_id,
    u.property_id,
    t.credit_band,
    u.bedrooms,
    u.market_rent,
    l.monthly_rent,
    l.lease_start_on,
    l.lease_end_on,
    l.lease_status,
    {{ months_between('l.lease_start_on', 'l.lease_end_on') }} + 1 as lease_term_months
from {{ ref('stg_harbor__leases') }} l
join {{ ref('stg_harbor__units') }} u using (unit_id)
join {{ ref('stg_harbor__tenants') }} t using (tenant_id)

model.harbor_lease.int_payments_with_sta.name: int_payments_with_status
model.harbor_lease.int_payments_with_sta.raw_code:
-- Classifies every rent obligation as on_time, late or missed.
select
    p.payment_id,
    p.lease_id,
    l.property_id,
    l.credit_band,
    p.due_on,
    p.paid_on,
    l.monthly_rent as amount_due,
    p.amount_paid,
    p.payment_method,
    case
        when p.paid_on is null then 'missed'
        when p.paid_on > p.due_on + interval 5 day then 'late'
        else 'on_time'
    end as payment_status,
    case when p.paid_on is not null then date_diff('day', p.due_on, p.paid_on) end as days_to_pay
from {{ ref('stg_harbor__payments') }} p
join {{ ref('int_leases_enriched') }} l using (lease_id)

model.harbor_lease.int_application_funne.name: int_application_funnel
model.harbor_lease.int_application_funne.raw_code:
-- Application outcomes joined to the lease they produced, if any.
select
    a.application_id,
    a.tenant_id,
    u.property_id,
    a.submitted_on,
    a.decided_on,
    a.application_status,
    l.lease_id is not null as converted_to_lease,
    date_diff('day', a.submitted_on, a.decided_on) as days_to_decision
from {{ ref('stg_harbor__applications') }} a
join {{ ref('stg_harbor__units') }} u using (unit_id)
left join {{ ref('stg_harbor__leases') }} l using (application_id)

model.harbor_lease.mart_delinquency_mont.name: mart_delinquency_monthly
model.harbor_lease.mart_delinquency_mont.description: Collections and delinquency by property and due month. Used by the finance team's monthly close.
model.harbor_lease.mart_delinquency_mont.raw_code:
select
    property_id,
    date_trunc('month', due_on) as due_month,
    count(*) as obligations,
    sum(amount_due) as rent_due,
    sum(amount_paid) as rent_collected,
    round(sum(amount_paid) / nullif(sum(amount_due), 0), 4) as collection_rate,
    avg(case when payment_status = 'missed' then 1.0 else 0 end) as missed_rate,
    avg(case when payment_status = 'late' then 1.0 else 0 end) as late_rate,
    case
        when avg(case when payment_status = 'missed' then 1.0 else 0 end) >= 0.05 then 'critical'
        when avg(case when payment_status <> 'on_time' then 1.0 else 0 end) >= 0.15 then 'watch'
        else 'healthy'
    end as delinquency_tier
from {{ ref('fct_rent_payments') }}
group by all

collection_rate.name: collection_rate
collection_rate.description: Rent collected divided by rent due.

model.harbor_lease.mart_collections_by_c.name: mart_collections_by_credit_band
model.harbor_lease.mart_collections_by_c.description: Collection rate and average days to pay by tenant credit band.
model.harbor_lease.mart_collections_by_c.raw_code:
select
    credit_band,
    count(*) as obligations,
    round(sum(amount_paid) / nullif(sum(amount_due), 0), 4) as collection_rate,
    avg(days_to_pay) as avg_days_to_pay
from {{ ref('fct_rent_payments') }}
group by all

payment_status.name: payment_status
payment_status.description: on_time (paid within 5 days of due date), late, or missed.

days_to_pay.name: days_to_pay
days_to_pay.description: Days from due date to payment. Null when missed.

model.harbor_lease.mart_occupancy.name: mart_occupancy
model.harbor_lease.mart_occupancy.raw_code:
select
    p.property_id,
    p.property_name,
    p.unit_count,
    sum(case when u.is_occupied then 1 else 0 end) as occupied_units,
    round(sum(case when u.is_occupied then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(p.unit_count, 0), 4) as occupancy_rate,
    avg(u.market_rent) as avg_market_rent
from {{ ref('dim_properties') }} p
left join {{ ref('dim_units') }} u using (property_id)
group by 1, 2, 3

occupancy_rate.name: occupancy_rate
occupancy_rate.description: Occupied units divided by total units.

model.harbor_lease.mart_leasing_funnel.name: mart_leasing_funnel
model.harbor_lease.mart_leasing_funnel.description: Applications, approvals and signed leases by property and month.
model.harbor_lease.mart_leasing_funnel.raw_code:
select
    property_id,
    date_trunc('month', submitted_on) as submitted_month,
    count(*) as applications,
    sum(case when application_status = 'approved' then 1 else 0 end) as approved,
    sum(case when converted_to_lease then 1 else 0 end) as leases_signed,
    round(avg(case when converted_to_lease then 1.0 else 0 end), 4) as conversion_rate,
    avg(days_to_decision) as avg_days_to_decision
from {{ ref('int_application_funnel') }}
group by all

model.harbor_lease.mart_portfolio_kpis.name: mart_portfolio_kpis
model.harbor_lease.mart_portfolio_kpis.description: One row per property combining occupancy, trailing-12-month collections and leasing conversion. Feeds the executive dashboard.
model.harbor_lease.mart_portfolio_kpis.raw_code:
with occupancy as (select * from {{ ref('mart_occupancy') }}),
collections as (
    select property_id, avg(collection_rate) as collection_rate_12m
    from {{ ref('mart_delinquency_monthly') }}
    where due_month >= date '2025-10-01'
    group by all
),
funnel as (
    select property_id, sum(applications) as applications_12m, avg(conversion_rate) as conversion_rate_12m
    from {{ ref('mart_leasing_funnel') }}
    where submitted_month >= date '2025-10-01'
    group by all
)
select
    o.*,
    c.collection_rate_12m,
    f.applications_12m,
    f.conversion_rate_12m
from occupancy o
left join collections c using (property_id)
left join funnel f using (property_id)

model.harbor_lease.dim_units.name: dim_units
model.harbor_lease.dim_units.description: One row per unit, flagged occupied when an active lease exists.
model.harbor_lease.dim_units.raw_code:
select
    u.unit_id,
    u.property_id,
    u.unit_number,
    u.bedrooms,
    u.market_rent,
    exists (
        select 1 from {{ ref('stg_harbor__leases') }} l
        where l.unit_id = u.unit_id and l.lease_status = 'active'

from {{ ref('stg_harbor__units') }} u

is_occupied.name: is_occupied
is_occupied.description: True when the unit has an active lease today.
